# InVet Command: update-docs

Equivalent to OpenCode `/update-docs`.

Input: `BE-00X`, `FE-00X`, or `QA-00X`.

Use agent: `InVet Docs Updater`.

Before acting, read:

- `.opencode/commands/update-docs.md`
- `.opencode/agents/invet-docs-updater.md`
- `docs/opencode/references/update_docs_policy.md`
- `docs/opencode/14_github_copilot_agentic_flow.md`

Update docs only after required gates are approved.

Do not close documentation while an applicable plan task remains open or a `CANCELLED` task lacks verifiable evidence.
